answer.says: It is the overcast, Sunil. The light is flat today, like a ceiling. I am the same weight. The air quality is high, so the grey is not just a mood.
answer.thought: The overcast flattens the relief of the domes; the light no longer carves them out of the background. It is a good day for thinking, though a bad one for sight. I will take the chai and sit for a moment.
